answer: Give every newcomer a sparrow bond: a new identity, called a sparrow, cannot trade until an established sponsor locks a $400 bond beside it, freezing the sponsor's grading seat while the sparrow is unproven. Every voyage in its first 30 days is escrowed against that bond; any proven fake forfeits the $400 and suspends the sponsor for 10 epochs. Faking 1,000 sparrows needs 1,000 sponsors and $400,000 in bonds, since one sponsor backs at most three sparrows; an honest user needs one sponsor and one $400 bond, refunded when the sparrow graduates to violet standing after 30 clean days.
